description: This source file defines data structures and functions related to Gateway configuration in a macOS application. It includes structs for configuration data, a function to load and parse the configuration from a JSON file, and a utility function to parse integers from various data types.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: Struct representing the gateway configuration, including mode, bind address, port, remote URL, and authentication credentials.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: Struct representing a gateway endpoint with URL, token, password, and mode.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads the gateway configuration from a JSON file in the user's home directory, parsing nested dictionaries for gateway, auth, and remote settings.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Utility function to convert various data types (Int, Double, String) into an optional Int.
